blockingIssues.detail: The skill is the first skill of U01 and lists no prerequisite skill, but the lecture and 13 of 14 assessments require fractions, square roots, irrational numbers or recurring decimals.
connections.previous says there is no prerequisite, while prerequisites requires fraction notation and square meaning.

recommendedStructure: U01 only teaches integers, zero, positive and negative numbers, fractions and finite decimals that are already prerequisites.
Move square-root and irrational-number classification to the square-root unit.
Teach recurring decimals before using them as evidence for rational-number classification.
After relocation, provide a later cumulative classification lesson.
